title: Spicy Egyptian Shrimp Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional kebabs, featuring succulent shrimp and a blend of Egyptian spices.

ingredients.name: Egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Egyptian spices, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add sliced onions and peppers to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Add coated onions and peppers to the skewers.
Brush kebabs with remaining spice mixture.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve hot with lemon juice squeezed over the top.
Enjoy as a light and flavorful lunch!
